meta.description: OVS flow evidence: datapath test pod-a(10.10.0.1) -> pod-b(10.10.0.2) over bridge br-ovs
meta.environment: Ubuntu 24.04, single-node k3s + Multus + OVS-CNI; both pod veths are ports on br-ovs
meta.note: ovs-ofctl in OVS 3.3.4 has no native --format=json (only -F flow-format / ovs-vsctl --format=json). These flows were captured from REAL command output (ovs-ofctl dump-flows + ovs-appctl dpctl/dump-flows -m) and serialized to JSON. The datapath_flows include per-flow packet/byte counters that prove the ping traffic (ARP + ICMP) traversed the bridge. Raw text is preserved verbatim under 'raw'.
